title: High-Dimensional Carrier-Assisted Entanglement Purification Based on Mutually Unbiased Bases
summary: Distilling high-dimensional entanglement under general asymmetric Pauli noise remains challenging. For the unprocessed qutrit single-carrier recurrence studied here, severe noise asymmetry can prevent the convergence condition from being satisfied. In this paper, we investigate carrier-assisted entanglement purification protocols, namely CAEPP and mCAEPP, first for two-qutrit systems, and show that the unprocessed single-carrier recurrence is bottlenecked by marginal $X$-error probabilities.
